source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As each [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) starts, you may choose one of the 2 imperatives below. Until that round ends it applies to your army, and every unit of yours with this ability gains its effects.

**PROTECTOR IMPERATIVE** gives the unit:

- **[[HEAVY]](vsdata:weapon-ability/heavy)** on its ranged weapons.
- Ballistic Skill of its ranged weapons improved by 1.
- −1 to the Hit rolls of melee attacks aimed at it, while it is **BATTLELINE** itself or has another **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE** unit of yours no more than 6" away.

**CONQUEROR IMPERATIVE** gives the unit:

- **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** on its ranged weapons.
- Weapon Skill of its melee weapons improved by 1.
- Armour Penetration improved by 1 on each attack its models make, under that same **BATTLELINE** condition.
